[color=#fffa00]Digiautos Championship[/color]

[color=#00ffa5]How to play:[/color]
You control a neon car that leaves a glowing trail behind it. Avoid crashing into your own trail or anyone else’s. Your objective is to be the last one standing.

[color=#00ffa5]Controls:[/color]
[color=#fffa00]\[←]\[→][/color]: Turn        [color=#fffa00]\[Space][/color]: Restart        [color=#fffa00]\[Esc][/color]: Pause

[color=#00ffa5]Before starting the game:[/color]
Press [color=#fffa00]\[←]\[→][/color] to select the number of opponents: [color=#fffa00]5[/color]

[color=#00ffa5]Good luck![/color]
Press [color=#fffa00]\[Space][/color] to start the game...
